The authors' code was run unchanged in a clean environment set up with the R
version the authors declared or, if they declared none, the one current when
the materials were deposited, and with packages as CRAN held them on the
snapshot date. This report records what happened. Whether
the results match those reported in the article is assessed by the checker in
the checklist issue.

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| R version | {{< meta r-version >}} |
| CRAN snapshot | {{< meta cran-snapshot >}} (Posit Package Manager) |
| Scripts run, in order | {{< meta entry-script >}} |
| Result | {{< meta result >}} |
| The deposit's `.Rprofile` | {{< meta authors-profile >}} |
| The deposit's `renv.lock` | {{< meta renv-lock >}} |

Each script was run in a fresh R session, from the root of the deposit, and
found there the files written by the scripts before it. Each has its own
section below: its exit status; the files it wrote, each compared with the
file of the same name in the deposit; its figures, those drawn on screen and
those saved as image files; the tables it saved as CSV or TSV; and its console
transcript, with every command as R executed it followed by its output. A
script still running after 60 minutes was stopped. Every file written is in
the artifact of this run, under `run/`.

{{< include _scripts.md >}}

## Deposited files no script wrote

Files in the deposit that none of the scripts wrote, leaving out code (R, R
Markdown and Quarto files), documentation (README, licence) and project files
(renv, RStudio, git). Some are
inputs, such as the data; any other is an output the authors deposited that
this run did not produce, and whose origin the code does not show.
